import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline


# Define custom CUDA kernel for element-wise division (x / rms)
def _elementwise_div_kernel(const float* a, const float* b, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] / b[idx];
    }
}

torch::Tensor elementwise_div_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_div_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size);

    return out;
}


# Define custom CUDA kernel for RMS normalization: x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)
def _rmsnorm_kernel(const float* a, const float* rms, float* out, int batch_size, int num_features, int total_elements) {
    // We'll do per-element division using block/thread layout.
    // For simplicity we implement elementwise division where each thread handles one element.
    // Use 1D grid of threads = total_elements. Block size 256.
    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (total_elements + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_div_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), rms.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), total_elements);
}


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_features: int, eps: float = 1e-5):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        self.num_features = num_features
        self.eps = eps

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Calculate RMS along feature dimension (dim=1)
        rms = torch.sqrt(torch.mean(x ** 2, dim=1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)

        # Normalize input by dividing by the RMS
        return x / rms
